invariants.title: Exclusive declaration ownership
invariants.conformanceMessage: Every observed member has exactly one declaring classifier.
invariants.violationMessage: At least one observed member has zero or multiple declaring classifiers.

invariants.title: Acyclic generalization
invariants.conformanceMessage: No inheritance cycle exists in the exact observed graph.
invariants.violationMessage: An inheritance cycle exists in the exact observed graph.

invariants.title: Inherited view derivation
invariants.conformanceMessage: The frontend-observed inherited view equals the Alloy-derived view.
invariants.violationMessage: At least one frontend-observed inherited membership differs from the Alloy-derived view.

invariants.title: Local and inherited separation
invariants.conformanceMessage: Local and frontend-observed inherited memberships are atom-disjoint.
invariants.violationMessage: At least one member atom is both local and inherited in the same classifier.

invariants.title: Implementation binding consistency
invariants.conformanceMessage: Each implementation body is bound by one explicit implementer-target-body relationship and local abstract/concrete methods obey the selected binding policy.
invariants.violationMessage: At least one implementation binding has an unavailable target, duplicate class-method binding, orphan/shared body, or invalid abstract/concrete local disposition.

invariants.title: Abstraction and unresolved implementation consistency
invariants.conformanceMessage: Every classifier with an unresolved visible method is explicitly abstract.
invariants.violationMessage: At least one classifier has unresolved visible implementation obligations without being explicitly abstract, or lacks abstraction evidence.

invariants.title: Static and abstract method separation
invariants.conformanceMessage: No source method is simultaneously static and abstract.
invariants.violationMessage: At least one source method is simultaneously static and abstract, or lacks required abstraction/scope evidence.

invariants.title: Local namespace uniqueness
invariants.conformanceMessage: Local method keys and attribute names are unique within each classifier.
invariants.violationMessage: At least one classifier contains a duplicate method key or attribute name.

invariants.title: Inherited namespace uniqueness
invariants.conformanceMessage: Inherited method keys and attribute names are unique within each classifier.
invariants.violationMessage: At least one classifier inherits distinct declarations with the same member key.

invariants.title: Override relation consistency
invariants.conformanceMessage: The independently frontend-resolved override relation agrees with the formal ancestor/signature/scope relation over the configured source boundary.
invariants.violationMessage: At least one independently resolved override pair disagrees with the formal ancestor/signature/scope relation; this is a bridge or policy-correspondence finding, not a return-type finding.

invariants.title: Override discipline
invariants.conformanceMessage: Every formal override pair satisfies the manuscript's strict equal-return and abstract-or-implemented policy when independent override evidence is available.
invariants.violationMessage: At least one formal override pair violates the strict equal-return or abstract-or-implemented policy.
